title: AP Precalculus
description: An offline-ready study framework for the complete AP Precalculus course.
disclaimer: Independent study aid. Not affiliated with or endorsed by College Board.

roadmap.heading: Grade max
roadmap.description: Farm XP across functions, trigonometry, polar coordinates, vectors, and matrices—with every official topic mapped.
roadmap.sectionDescription: Units 1–3 are assessed on the AP Exam. Unit 4 completes the course framework and is clearly marked as optional exam content.

tools.heading: The right tool
tools.description: Graph functions, run regressions, inspect transformations, and work with matrices using free browser tools. External tools require an internet connection.

reference.heading: The formulas
reference.description: A compact reference for functions, algebra, trigonometry, polar coordinates, vectors, matrices, and modeling.
reference.noteText: Practice moving between equations, graphs, tables, and context. On the AP Exam, a calculator can support your reasoning—but your setup and interpretation still matter.

practice.heading: Lock in.
practice.description: Build a Unit 1 training session, put in focused reps, and grade max AP Precalculus at your own pace. More units are coming.
